title: Observability: Health, Metriken und inhaltsfreie Logs
description: As an operator, I want health, metrics and content free logs, so that I can operate the platform without reading user data.

acceptance_criteria.when: the operator queries the health endpoint and the metrics endpoint
acceptance_criteria.then: both respond with 200 and report queue depth, scan duration, error rate, delivery rate and status distribution
and: every log line carries a correlation id
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-032-observability.feature: Health, metrics and structured logs are available

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt with a secret and a customer name is created and later flagged
acceptance_criteria.when: all log lines of that request are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: no log line contains the prompt text, the secret, the customer name or the finding excerpts
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-032-observability.feature: Log lines never contain prompt content

acceptance_criteria.given: an unexpected internal error occurs in a request handler
acceptance_criteria.when: the client receives the error response
acceptance_criteria.then: the response contains a generic error and a correlation id and no stack trace or internal detail
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-032-observability.feature: Internal errors are not leaked to the client
